Source.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/4] The GDI is a 27-item self-report instrument; The HRSD is a clinician-rated measure of depression severity; The CBCL Depression Scale (CBCL-D) was completed by each adolescent's parent or guardian. [/page/1/Text/5] The ATQ is a 30-item self-report measure; The DAS is a 40 item self-report scale. [/page/1/Text/6] The CBT is a 20-item true-false scale that was developed to ascertain participants' comprehension and retention. [/page/1/Text/7] Compliance was measured by participants' self-report; Participation was assessed by recording the number of written exercises completed.

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/4] Depression severity measures included the GDI, the HRSD, and Aehenbach's Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL). The CBCL-D as corroborative information for the GDI and the HRSD. [/page/1/Text/5] The Automatic Thoughts Questionnaire (ATQ) and the Dysfunctional Attitude Scale (DAS) were used to assess the cognitive correlates of depression.
